summary: Part I.8 of the blueprint for arithmetic Iwasawa theory. This first checkpoint plans L0: the cyclotomic tower ℚ(μ_m) ⊆ ℂ with compatible roots, Galois groups and relative norms (the carrier EulerSystemsCyclotomicMainConjecture:L0 requests), the real subfields, the cyclotomic units D_n and D_n^+ of ℚ(μ_{p^n}) with their generators and cyclicity over ℤ[Γ_n^+], the equality of full and real indices, and the index formula h_n^+ = [V_n^+ : D_n^+] with its analytic steps recorded as a gap. The other stages are not yet read.

nodes.title: The cyclotomic tower in ℂ
nodes.statement: The compatible roots ζ_m = exp(2πi/m) ∈ ℂ (ζ_{mn}^n = ζ_m) and the subfields ℚ(μ_m) = ℚ(ζ_m) ⊆ ℂ, with ℚ(μ_m) ⊆ ℚ(μ_n) for m ∣ n, each an m-th cyclotomic extension of ℚ and a number field, and the relative norms N_{ℚ(μ_n)/ℚ(μ_m)} (Mathlib's Algebra.norm on the extension of scalars).
hypotheses: m ≥ 1 for the cyclotomic-extension instance; ℚ(μ_m) = ℚ(μ_{2m}) for odd m.
proofSteps: Complex.isPrimitiveRoot_exp gives primitivity; compatibility is exp arithmetic; integrality from being a root of unity; the tower inclusions from ζ_m = ζ_n^{n/m}.
acceptance: This is the carrier requested by EulerSystemsCyclotomicMainConjecture:L0 and fixed by RS-16 in this layer.

nodes.title: Galois groups and norms along the tower
nodes.statement: For m ∣ n: relative norms are transitive, N_{ℚ(μ_n)/ℚ(μ_k)} = N_{ℚ(μ_m)/ℚ(μ_k)} ∘ N_{ℚ(μ_n)/ℚ(μ_m)}; and restriction Gal(ℚ(μ_n)/ℚ) → Gal(ℚ(μ_m)/ℚ) is reduction (ℤ/n)^× → (ℤ/m)^× under Mathlib's autEquivPow, so relative norms commute with the Galois action.
proofSteps: Algebra.norm_norm for the tower of extensions.
σ_a(ζ_n) = ζ_n^a restricts to ζ_m ↦ ζ_m^a because ζ_m = ζ_n^{n/m}.
acceptance: Needed for every norm relation of the Euler system of cyclotomic units.

nodes.title: The real subfields ℚ(μ_m)^+
nodes.statement: ℚ(μ_m)^+ = ℚ(ζ_m + ζ_m^{−1}) ⊆ ℚ(μ_m), the fixed field of complex conjugation, which is Mathlib's maximal real subfield of the CM field ℚ(μ_m) (m > 2), of index 2.
hypotheses: m > 2 for the index-two statement; for m ≤ 2 both fields are ℚ.
proofSteps: ζ + ζ^{−1} is real; ℚ(μ_m) = ℚ(μ_m)^+(ζ) with ζ² − (ζ + ζ^{−1})ζ + 1 = 0; compare with Mathlib's CM structure (IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.isCMField, IsCMField.complexConj).

api.name: TauCeti.CyclotomicTower.mem_QmuPlus_iff
api.statement: x ∈ ℚ(μ_m)^+ iff x is fixed by complex conjugation.

nodes.title: Cyclotomic units D_n and D_n^+
nodes.statement: For an odd prime p and n ≥ 1, D_n is the intersection of 𝓞^×_{ℚ(μ_{p^n})} with the subgroup of ℚ(μ_{p^n})^× generated by ±ζ_{p^n} and ζ_{p^n}^a − 1 (1 ≤ a < p^n), and D_n^+ = D_n ∩ ℚ(μ_{p^n})^+.
hypotheses: p odd, n ≥ 1 (RJW assume p odd throughout Part II).
proofSteps: Subgroup closure intersected with the integral units.
acceptance: D_n is a subgroup of the actual units, as the stage requires; its elements need not be products of generators with nonnegative exponents.

tests.name: D_nonunit_generator
tests.statement: ζ_{p^n} − 1 itself is not in D_n (its norm is p).

nodes.title: The units c_n(a) and γ_{n,a}
nodes.statement: For (a, p) = 1: c_n(a) = (ζ^a − 1)/(ζ − 1) = ∑_{i<a} ζ^i ∈ D_n, and γ_{n,a} = ζ^{(1−a)/2} c_n(a) = (ζ^{a/2} − ζ^{−a/2})/(ζ^{1/2} − ζ^{−1/2}) ∈ D_n^+, where ζ^{1/2} is the square root of ζ in μ_{p^n} (p odd).
proofSteps: c_n(a) is a unit (IsPrimitiveRoot.geom_sum_isUnit); γ_{n,a} is fixed by complex conjugation by the second formula.

api.name: TauCeti.CyclotomicTower.isUnit_cUnit
api.statement: c_n(a) is a unit for (a, p) = 1.

uses.how: c(a) = (c_n(a))_n in the local units, Coleman power series ((1+T)^a − 1)/T

nodes.title: Reduction to exponents prime to p
nodes.statement: For p odd, (b, p) = 1 and 1 ≤ m < n: ζ^{bp^m} − 1 = ∏_{j<p^m} (ζ^{b + jp^{n−m}} − 1), with every exponent b + jp^{n−m} prime to p.
hypotheses: p odd (for p = 2 the product carries a sign).
acceptance: So D_n is generated by ±ζ and the ζ^a − 1 with (a, p) = 1.

nodes.title: Exponent sums of units vanish
nodes.statement: For (a, p) = 1, ζ^a − 1 is associated to ζ − 1 (so all have the same p-adic valuation 1/((p−1)p^{n−1})); hence if ±ζ^d ∏_a (ζ^a − 1)^{e_a} is a unit then ∑_a e_a = 0.
proofSteps: IsPrimitiveRoot.associated_sub_one_pow_sub_one_of_coprime; take the valuation at the unique prime above p.
acceptance: This is where integrality enters the definition of D_n.

nodes.title: Generators of the cyclotomic units
nodes.statement: For p odd and n ≥ 1: D_n^+ is generated by −1 and γ_{n,a} (1 < a < p^n/2, (a, p) = 1), and D_n = ⟨ζ_{p^n}⟩·D_n^+.
proofSteps: prime-to-p-reduction and ζ^a − 1 = −ζ^a(ζ^{−a} − 1) reduce to 1 ≤ a < p^n/2, (a, p) = 1.
valuation-balance gives ∑ e_a = 0, so the element is ±ζ^e ∏ γ_{n,a}^{e_a} with e = d + ½∑e_a(a − 1).
γ_{n,a} are real, so the element is in D_n^+ iff e = 0.
acceptance: The torsion of D_n is μ_{2p^n}.

nodes.title: D_n^+ is cyclic over ℤ[Γ_n^+]
nodes.statement: If a generates (ℤ/p^n)^×, then D_n^+ = ℤ[Γ_n^+]·γ_{n,a}: every γ_{n,b} is ∏_{i<r} σ_a^i(γ_{n,a}) for b ≡ a^r, and −1 = γ_{n,−1} is included.
hypotheses: p odd; a a primitive root modulo p^n.
proofSteps: σ_a^i(γ_{n,a}) = γ_{n,a^{i+1}}/γ_{n,a^i}; the product telescopes to γ_{n,a^r} = γ_{n,b} (the ζ^{(1−b)/2} factors telescope too).
acceptance: Equivalently N_{ℚ(μ_{p^n})^+/ℚ}(γ_{n,a}) = −1, checked numerically for p ≤ 11, n ≤ 3.

nodes.title: Full and real unit indices agree
nodes.statement: For p odd, [V_n : D_n] = [V_n^+ : D_n^+], where V_n = 𝓞^×_{ℚ(μ_{p^n})}; equivalently Hasse's unit index Q(ℚ(μ_{p^n})) = 1, so V_n = μ_{2p^n}·V_n^+.
proofSteps: Hasse's unit index is 1 or 2 (NumberField.IsCMField.indexRealUnits_eq_one_or_two), and it is 2 iff some unit u has u/ū not of the form ζ²ᵏ; for ℚ(μ_{p^n}) every unit is ζ^k times a real unit (NumberField.IsCMField.indexRealUnits_eq_two_iff with the prime (ζ − 1) above p).
cyclotomic-unit-generators gives D_n = ⟨ζ⟩·D_n^+ with the same torsion; the indices agree.
acceptance: Fails for general CM fields, where Q = 2 can occur.

nodes.title: The cyclotomic unit index formula
nodes.statement: For p odd and n ≥ 1, D_n^+ has finite index in V_n^+ and [V_n^+ : D_n^+] = h_n^+ = #Cl(ℚ(μ_{p^n})^+); hence also [V_n : D_n] = h_n^+.
proofSteps: Reg(D_n^+) = [V_n^+ : D_n^+]·Reg(V_n^+) (both of full rank).
Reg(D_n^+) is a group determinant over Γ_n^+, which factors as ∏_{χ ≠ 1 even} of −½∑_a χ(a) log|1 − ζ^a|.
For even χ ≠ 1 of conductor f, L(1, χ) = −(τ(χ)/f)∑_a χ̄(a) log|1 − ζ_f^a|; nonvanishing is Mathlib's DirichletCharacter.LFunction_apply_one_ne_zero.
ζ_{ℚ(μ_{p^n})^+}(s) = ∏_{χ even} L(s, χ) and the analytic class number formula for ℚ(μ_{p^n})^+ (Mathlib's residue of the Dedekind zeta function) combine to h_n^+ Reg(V_n^+) = Reg(D_n^+).
unit-index-real-full gives the full-field equality.
acceptance: The analytic steps are not decomposed in this checkpoint; see gaps.

gaps.title: Analytic steps of the index formula
gaps.detail: The regulator computation of Washington, Introduction to Cyclotomic Fields, Theorem 8.2 (which RJW cite for Theorem 11.7) was not accessed. Missing as nodes: the formula L(1, χ) = −(τ(χ)/f)∑χ̄(a)log|1 − ζ_f^a| for even χ, the factorisation ζ_{ℚ(μ_m)^+} = ∏_{χ even} L(s, χ), the group determinant over Γ_n^+, and the discriminant of ℚ(μ_{p^n})^+ in the class number formula.

sourceIssues.locator: §12.3, Corollary 12.19 and its proof, p. 63 (arXiv v2)
sourceIssues.correction: c_n(b) = (ξ^{a^r} − 1)/(ξ − 1) = ∏_{i<r} σ_a^i(c_n(a)); multiplying by ξ^{(1−b)/2} = ∏_{i<r} σ_a^i(ξ^{(1−a)/2}) gives γ_{n,b} = ∏_{i<r} σ_a^i(γ_{n,a}).
sourceIssues.reason: γ_{n,b} = ξ^{(1−b)/2} c_n(b), so the first equality drops the root-of-unity factor, and the middle product is c_n(a)-quotients, not γ_{n,a}'s. The telescoping of the exponents ∑_{i<r} a^i(1 − a) = 1 − a^r restores the stated conclusion.
